1.name: Lucky Goldfish
1.skill_desc: Every instance of damage taken will not surpass 30% of self Maximum HP (The amount of damage reduced will not exceed 100% of the owner's Maximum HP. This effect can only be triggered 3 times per Round).

2.name: Floating Jellyfish
2.skill_desc: In battle the owner of the Set gains 0.5% Damage Reduction for every 1% Crit Resist she has. When she takes a Critical Strike from Basic Attacks or Active Skills she will gain 30% Crit Resist that lasts for 1 Round.

3.name: Rock Crab
3.skill_desc:
At the start of the Round the owner of the Set gains 1 stack of Carapace that lasts for 1 round.

Carapace: A Skill Effect.
Whenever the owner of this Effect takes damage she will consume 1 stack of Carapace to nullify the damage.

4.name: Ghostly Goat
4.skill_desc: For every 3 instances of damage dealt the owner of the Set will deal 60% more damage in the next instance of damage she deals.

5.name: Fiery Qilin
5.skill_desc: Increases damage dealt to enemies with more than 80% HP by 40%.

6.name: Cunning Lizard
6.skill_desc: Increases damage dealt to Boss enemies by 50%.

7.name: Nine-Tailed Fox
7.skill_desc: At the end of the round if the owner of the Set dealt a Basic Attack or were unable to attack in the round all allies will gain 15% Block and 15% Control Immunity that lasts for 2 rounds.

8.name: Weaver Kitty
8.skill_desc: Increase the amount of BP gained by 25%. When the owner of the Set releases her Active Skill if she is protected by a [c][e28002]Magick Barrier[-][/c] her ally with the lowest HP will gain a [c][e28002]Magick Barrier[-][/c] with (20% of the ally's Maximum HP) BP.

9.name: Majestic Phoenix
9.skill_desc: Increase Heal Amount by 25%. When the owner of this Set is healed 1 random Debuff (Damage Over Time Attribute Reduction Mark Control Effect) will be removed from 1 random ally (This effect can only be triggered once per Round).
